purpose: Turn first-time exploration into persistent knowledge without changing the film story.
rules: A registered Journey Discovery creates exactly one Chronicle entry ID.
A registered Journey Discovery marks its route/chapter region as known.
Repeated discovery cannot duplicate Chronicle entries or map regions.
Book Chronicles remain a separate continuity layer and are not inserted into this main-film runtime registry.
Knowledge unlocks may improve context, navigation and dialogue availability but never advance or reorder FILM_CORE.

runtime.ui: C toggles Chronicle & Journey; LeftBracket/RightBracket browse persistent discovered entries while known regions remain visible.
runtime.display_metadata: Journey discovery display labels are loaded from Data/JourneyDiscoveryRewardPlan.json and paired with region/chapter/category context.

progression_bridge.behavior: If a discovery is linked to a contextual side activity, the activity type adds bounded track XP on the same first-time registration.
